newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end lower as soybean values slip.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end lower as soybean values slip.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed lower on a late slide in soybean futures with concerns about a trade conflict with China also cited, traders said.
China said Monday it expected talks with the United States soon on a dispute over U.S. sanctions on its textiles and its own threat to retaliate.
Position squaring was noted before the release Tuesday of USDA's November crop production and supply/demand reports.
Soyoil closed 0.01 to 0.24 cent per lb lower, with December down 0.24 at 22.75 cents.
Soymeal was $3.90 per ton lower to $0.20 higher, with December down $2.90 at $226.70 a ton.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 10,000 contracts, below the 14,577 traded Friday, according to the CBOT.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 18,000 contracts, below the 28,244 traded Friday.
